name: nuclear receptor subfamily 0 group B member 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: NR0B1 encodes nuclear receptor subfamily 0 group B member 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to X-linked adrenal hypoplasia congenita (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
